notes.title: VIVE update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everybody![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31389654/2816326fe9299e3a27cbfbf7e977274338fc3201.png[/img]

We are glad to announce that "INTERNAL LIGHT VR" is ready for HTC VIVE headsets.

There was a huge problem with current Unreal Engine version. But weve work hard and fix that.

We wish you a pleasant playing on HTC VIVE!

notes.title: Release news!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everybody![/h1]

We have some important news for you. For the past few days we've done some improvement in "INTERNAL LIGHT VR".
[list]
[*]Telekinesis - for better item pick up!
[*]Better performance on GTX970!
[*]New level!
[/list]
And the most important announcement, due to unresolved issue we will release game [b]ONLY for OCULUS[/b]. As this project is only two people work, we need more time  to make it playable for VIVE. But dont worry we will work hard and will make it AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. If you want to TEST it on VIVE you can download, and we can make it faster with your help!

notes.title: "Internal Light VR" Ready for release!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31389654/d59d9943f835be70e3c85734136bed30737195e3.png[/img]
[h1][b]Greetings on behalf of Hot Dogs Studio![/b][/h1]

Previous few weeks was full of work. And today we glad to announce to you that "INTERNAL LIGHT VR" is ready for release.For the release version we have done:
[olist]
[*]4 new levels, with new quest and challenges
[*] Optimization for 970 NVIDIA
[*]Tons of bugs are fixed ;D
[b]and the most important :[/b]
[*] [url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31389654/782ee21ec1b97eb32867a31d9e59efc767a407c4.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31389654/2816326fe9299e3a27cbfbf7e977274338fc3201.png[/img][/url][b]support[/b]
[/olist]
As we finished the release verison we are [b]not stopping work[/b] with "INTERNAL LIGHT", and we will work hard to make it better for our players. Hope to see your reviews as soon as the game will be reliased!
                                                                      
BR
